title: User Registration and Login with Valid Credentials
steps: Open registration form; enter valid name, unique email, and password; submit; log in with credentials
expected: User is registered successfully and lands on the dashboard with an active session

title: User Logout and Session Expiry
steps: Log in to application; click logout button; attempt to access dashboard URL directly
expected: Session is terminated and user is redirected to login page

title: Duplicate Email Registration Rejection
steps: Register an account with an email address that already exists in the system
expected: Registration is rejected with a clear error message indicating duplicate email

title: Project Creation and Management
steps: Log in as authorized user; click New Project; enter project name; save; rename and archive project
expected: Project is created, listed on dashboard, successfully renamed, and archived

title: Project Creation with Empty Name
steps: Click New Project; leave project name blank; attempt to save
expected: Validation error shown; project is not created

title: Submit Raw Requirements Text
steps: Open project requirements tab; paste typed requirement text; submit
expected: Raw requirements are stored against the project successfully

title: Upload Supported and Oversize Requirement Files
steps: Upload a valid 5 MB PDF requirement file; upload an 11 MB PDF file
expected: 5 MB PDF is parsed and stored; 11 MB PDF is rejected with an oversize error

title: Generate IEEE 830 SRS Draft with Unique IDs
steps: Submit valid requirement input; invoke SRS draft generation endpoint
expected: SRS draft generated with IEEE 830 structure, unique requirement IDs (FR-xx, NFR-xx), and human review notice

title: SRS Versioning, Editing, and Approval
steps: Edit generated SRS content; save changes to create new version; compare versions; mark latest version as approved
expected: New version created, differences displayed correctly, and approval timestamp/user recorded

title: Save Empty SRS Content Rejection
steps: Clear all text in SRS editor; attempt to save
expected: Save is rejected with a clear error message; no new version is created

title: Independent Test Case Generation from Approved SRS
steps: Provide approved SRS JSON to LLM-B test agent; invoke test case generation
expected: Positive, negative, and boundary test cases generated for every requirement with all mandatory fields

title: Test Case Generation Blocked for Unapproved SRS
steps: Attempt to generate test cases while SRS is in draft unapproved status
expected: Generation is blocked with a message requiring SRS approval first

title: Requirements Traceability Matrix and Coverage Display
steps: Navigate to Traceability tab after test case generation
expected: Matrix displays requirements linked to test cases, coverage percentage, and highlights uncovered items

title: Export Artifacts to DOCX and CSV
steps: Click export buttons for SRS (DOCX) and test cases / traceability matrix (CSV)
expected: Files download successfully and open correctly in standard office tools matching screen content

title: Test Plan Generation
steps: Click Generate Test Plan on an approved SRS
expected: Test plan generated containing scope, approach, environment, schedule, and risks

title: UML Diagram Generation and Rendering
steps: Click Generate Diagrams from approved SRS
expected: Use-case, class, and sequence diagram definitions generated and rendered as viewable images

title: Ambiguity and Conflict Detection in SRS Draft
steps: Input requirement containing ambiguous words ('fast', 'user-friendly') and conflicts; run check
expected: System flags ambiguous phrasing, conflicting statements, and missing sections with suggestions

title: Role-Based Access Control and Permissions
steps: Attempt SRS approval and admin actions using QA Engineer and Developer user tokens
expected: Actions are denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden response

title: Software Architecture Document (SAD) Generation
steps: Trigger SAD generation from approved SRS
expected: SAD generated with system components and rationale tied directly to requirement IDs

title: Audit Log Recording and Administrator Access
steps: Perform create, edit, approve, and export actions; log in as Administrator to view audit log
expected: Audit entries recorded with timestamp, actor, and action; viewable strictly by Administrator

title: Automated Playwright Test Script Generation
steps: Run Test Agent script generator on test cases JSON
expected: One executable Playwright test script generated per test case carrying correct TC and requirement IDs

title: Automated Test Execution and Execution Report Generation
steps: Execute test script runner without human intervention
expected: Tests executed, pass/fail status and duration recorded, and HTML/CSV/JUnit reports generated
